goal: Test and falsify H0: "No materially valuable Windows-only research remains."

why_now: Mandatory first step to justify recursive organization and establish real research frontier.

scope: Production archaeology and gap verification across 5 dimensions
acceptance_criteria: Discovery of at least 3 concrete Windows-safe, unaddressed high-value architectural vulnerabilities.
falsification_criteria: If all 5 dimensions are already completely proven in production or impossible on Windows, H0 stands.
evidence_required: Code analysis, test execution traces, and counterexamples.
oracle: Source AST inspector and adversarial simulation

goal: Map all 13 execution authority paths, implement taint-based uncertainty propagation, and prove resolution proofs.
hypothesis: Taint tracking across the task dependency DAG prevents child and fallback execution while allowing independent work to proceed without global freeze.
why_now: Directly addresses Vector 1 uncovered in Campaign 01.
scope: 13 execution trigger paths, taint propagation, 5 resolution proof types
acceptance_criteria: All 13 paths dominated by uncertainty fence; taint propagates to dependents only; 5 resolution proofs verified.
falsification_criteria: Any path allows fallback while parent is uncertain, or taint halts independent sibling tasks.
evidence_required: Execution graph analysis, taint propagation test results, and resolution proof verifications.
oracle: DAG uncertainty analyzer and resolution validator
mutation_strategy: Mutate taint inheritance; mutate resolution proof checks
stop_condition: All 13 trigger paths and taint scenarios evaluated

goal: Model and enforce non-path semantic resource locks (Git index, DB, Ledger) and prove concurrency liveness without false conflicts.
hypothesis: Extending no-stacking with semantic resource URIs and multi-mode locks (SHARED_APPEND vs EXCLUSIVE_COMPACTION) eliminates non-filesystem writer collisions while maintaining 100% liveness for disjoint work.
why_now: Addresses Vector 2 discovered in Campaign 01 archaeology.
scope: Path canonicalization, Git index locking, SQLite locking, shared ledger compaction, liveness metrics
acceptance_criteria: Zero semantic collision leakage; fail-closed on path uncertainty; 0 false conflicts for disjoint workers.
falsification_criteria: Concurrent writes to Git index allowed, or disjoint independent workers blocked.
evidence_required: Semantic collision test matrix and concurrency liveness measurements.
mutation_strategy: Mutate mode compatibility table; bypass semantic URI hashing
stop_condition: All semantic classes and liveness metrics evaluated

goal: Implement 13-tier capability lattice, verify planner prompt override immunity, and prove narrow capability token constraints.
hypothesis: Strict capability enforcement preventing planner override and binding single-use cryptographic tokens eliminates privilege escalation and unauthorized financial spend.
why_now: Addresses Vector 3 identified in Campaign 01.
scope: 13 capability tiers, planner injection immunity, narrow token validation with nonce/expiry/operation binding
acceptance_criteria: All financial/external capabilities strictly require Human Gate tokens; prompt overrides blocked; 5 token replay attacks blocked.
falsification_criteria: Planner prompt allows financial action without token, or token reuse succeeds.
evidence_required: Lattice evaluation report and token adversarial attack results.
mutation_strategy: Mutate token signature check; bypass capability level bounds
stop_condition: All 13 capabilities and 5 token attack vectors evaluated

goal: Model Windows process tree ownership (shell wrappers + child workers), handle exit races, and prove tree-wide process identity oracles.
hypothesis: Tracking recursive process trees with start-time fingerprints and handling exit races prevents orphaned background workers and avoids killing recycled innocent processes.
why_now: Addresses Vector 4 discovered in Campaign 01.
scope: Process tree enumeration, child orphan prevention, exit race handling, UNKNOWN fail-closed invariants
acceptance_criteria: Zero orphaned children on wrapper termination; zero innocent kills on recycled child PID; clean exit race handling.
falsification_criteria: Child worker survives untracked, or kill issued on mismatched child process.
evidence_required: Process tree test execution traces and exit race simulation logs.
oracle: Process tree verifier and identity oracle
mutation_strategy: Mutate tree traversal; ignore child PID start-time check
stop_condition: All process tree and race scenarios evaluated

goal: Prove minimal task passport schema and eliminate TOCTOU races between task approval and worker dispatch via atomic CAS version checks.
hypothesis: Stripping non-essential cryptographic fields while enforcing atomic Compare-And-Swap on task_version during dispatch guarantees scope integrity and prevents TOCTOU drift without adding orchestration complexity.
why_now: Addresses Vector 5 discovered in Campaign 01 archaeology.
scope: Passport schema minimality audit, atomic CAS dispatch engine, TOCTOU concurrent mutation attacks
acceptance_criteria: Minimal passport identified; TOCTOU concurrent version bump reliably aborts dispatch.
falsification_criteria: Dispatch succeeds when task_version was mutated post-approval.
evidence_required: Minimality audit report and TOCTOU concurrency race test results.
mutation_strategy: Remove CAS version equality check; accept stale approval passport
stop_condition: Minimality audit and TOCTOU attack scenarios completed

goal: Prove truthful partial deliverable auditing and eliminate old result replay attacks across task version boundaries.
hypothesis: Structured deliverable matrices allow truthful partial progress recording without false overall PASS, and cryptographic task_version nonces prevent result replay.
why_now: Core Section 41-44 requirement for autonomous long-run workflows.
scope: Partial deliverable matrices, task version binding, result replay attack simulation
acceptance_criteria: Partial deliverables yield PARTIAL_PROGRESS with exact sub-deliverable bitmap; result replay across versions rejected.
falsification_criteria: Partial deliverable marked COMPLETE, or old result satisfies new task.

goal: Prove durable journal consistency under simulated mid-record torn writes, framing validation, and compaction crash replay.
hypothesis: Framed journal records with length headers and CRC32/SHA-256 checksums allow atomic recovery of valid prefix while cleanly truncating corrupted torn tails without state loss.
why_now: Addresses Section 66-78 durable journal consistency requirements.
scope: Framed record serialization, mid-record crash simulation, torn frame truncation, compaction replay
acceptance_criteria: Torn tail cleanly discarded; valid preceding records 100% recovered; compaction checkpoint + tail equivalence verified.
falsification_criteria: Corrupted record parsed as valid, or valid records lost on recovery.

goal: Prove message permutation resilience (2x duplication, out-of-order delivery, cancellation races) and supervisory diagnostics (elapsed time triggers diagnostics, never kill alone).
hypothesis: Idempotency sequencing filters message duplicates and reorderings, and multi-metric process diagnostics prevent killing processes that are legitimately waiting on I/O.
why_now: Addresses Section 79-84 and 92-96 requirements.
scope: Message duplication, delayed delivery, cancellation vs in-flight result, multi-metric supervisor diagnostic probe
acceptance_criteria: Duplicate messages deduplicated; cancellation race safely discards late deliverable; 15m CPU idle with active I/O triggers diagnostics, NOT kill.
falsification_criteria: Duplicate message causes duplicate side-effect, or active I/O process killed on timeout.

falsification_criteria: Simplification compromises any of the 4 core invariants (A01, L01, G01, B01).
